title: Thai Pork Skillet
description: A hearty and flavorful Thai-inspired pork dish cooked in a skillet, perfect for a quick weeknight dinner. The sweet and spicy flavors will transport your taste buds to the streets of Bangkok.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the pork and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from the skillet.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil to the skillet. Add the onions and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the curry paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the bell peppers and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the fish sauce, brown sugar, and soy sauce. Stir to combine.
Return the pork to the skillet. Cook until heated through, about 2-3 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
Serve with steamed rice or noodles to soak up the sauce.
